{{< include ../_extensions/r-wasm/live/_knitr.qmd >}}


```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof N=Inputs.range([0,500], {step: 5, value: 100, label:"Sample size (n)"})
viewof d=Inputs.range([0.5,6], {step: 0.5, value: 6, label:"Effect size (d)"})
viewof A=Inputs.range([0,0.2], {step: 0.05, value: 0.05, label:"Significance level (alpha)"})

```



```{webr}
#| input:
#|   - N
#|   - d
#|   - A
#| autorun: true
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
dc_pop <- readRDS("data/dc_pop.rds")
theme_set(theme_minimal())
pwr_graphic <- function(d = d, sdv = sd(dc_pop$age), n = N, alpha = A) {
  mu1 <- 35
  mu2 <- mu1 + d
  sdev <- sdv / sqrt(n)
  critval <- qnorm(1 - alpha, mean = mu1, sd = sdev)
  pwr <- 1 - pnorm(critval, mean = mu2, sd = sdev)
  tibble(x = seq(28, 50, length.out = 100)) |>
    mutate(y1 = dnorm(x, mu1, sdev), y2 = dnorm(x, mu2, sdev)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = x)) +
    stat_function(
      fun = dnorm,
      args = list(mean = mu1, sd = sdev),
      color = "blue",
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    stat_function(
      fun = dnorm,
      args = list(mean = mu2, sd = sdev),
      color = "red",
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    stat_function(
      fun = dnorm,
      args = list(mean = mu2, sd = sdev),
      geom = "area",
      fill = "red",
      xlim = c(critval, 47),
      alpha = 0.5
    ) +
    stat_function(
      fun = dnorm,
      args = list(mean = mu1, sd = sdev),
      geom = "area",
      fill = "blue",
      xlim = c(critval, 47),
      alpha = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      x = mu1,
      xend = mu2,
      y = dnorm(mu1, mu1, sdev) + 0.01,
      yend = dnorm(mu1, mu1, sdev) + 0.01,
      arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), ends = "both")
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = (mu1 + mu2) / 2,
      y = dnorm(mu1, mu1, sdev) + 0.02,
      ,
      label = glue::glue("Effect size = {d} years")
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      x = mu1 - sdev,
      xend = mu1 + sdev,
      y = dnorm(mu1 - sdev, mu1, sdev),
      yend = dnorm(mu1 + sdev, mu1, sdev),
      arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), ends = "both")
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = mu1,
      y = dnorm(mu1 - sdev, mu1, sdev) + 0.01,
      label = sprintf("2\u03c3 / \u221a(n)")
    ) +
    labs(x = "Age") +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = mu1,
      y = dnorm(mu1, mu1, sdev) + 0.05,
      label = "Null hypothesis",
      color = "blue"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = mu2,
      y = dnorm(mu2, mu2, sdev) + 0.04,
      label = "Alternative hypothesis",
      color = "red"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = mu2 + 2 * sdev,
      y = dnorm(critval, mu1, sdev) / 2,
      hjust = -0.1,
      label = glue::glue("Power = {round(pwr*100,1)}%"),
      color = "red"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = critval,
      y = 0.5 * dnorm(critval, mu1, sdev),
      hjust = 1.1,
      label = "Type I error(\u03b1)",
      color = "blue"
    ) +
    geom_textvline(
      xintercept = critval,
      linetype = 2,
      label = "Critical value"
    ) +
    annotate(
      'text',
      x = mu2 + 2 * sdev,
      y = dnorm(mu2, mu2, sdev) * .8,
      label = glue::glue(
        "Sample size = {n}\nStd. Dev. = {round(sdv,1)}\nSignif. level = {alpha}"
      ),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 0
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}
pwr_graphic(d = d, n = N, alpha = A)
```
